        Idea:
Implement Phase 5 (Lifecycle verbs split by audience) of the ArtAgents orchestrator V1 design per docs/orchestrator-v1-plan.md section 8. Phase 5 scope: introduce three audience-scoped verb groups under the top-level CLI:

  artagents next | ack | status | abort               (agent-facing, mid-run)
  artagents start | abort | status | runs ls          (operator)
  artagents author new | check | describe | test | compile | explain   (author; new/check/describe/compile already shipped in Phase 4)

Wire them into artagents/pipeline.py via subcommands. The agent-facing verbs and operator verbs should NOT collide with existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` (which stays). Specifically:

- `artagents start <orchestrator-id> --project <slug> [--name "..."]`: materializes the plan from compiled JSON, hashes it, writes active_run.json, appends run_started to events.jsonl, writes AGENT.md as the contract for whoever's driving.
- `artagents next`: reads active_run.json, derives cursor from events.jsonl (Phase 1 kernel API), prints next legal command/instruction with the prohibition preamble verbatim every call (so Stop hooks re-inject context). For code steps prints the exact argv to run; for attested prints instructions + ack template. For repeat:until iterations and repeat:for_each items, prints cumulative feedback / item ledger.
- `artagents ack <step> --decision {approve,retry,iterate,abort} [--evidence path] [--agent id | --actor name] [--feedback "..."] [--item id]`: validates ack against current step + decision rules (retry only after verifier failure; iterate only when repeat.until=user_approves), appends ack event, runs inline produces checks where applicable, advances cursor or rewinds.
- `artagents abort`: ends the run, writes run_aborted event, removes active_run.json.
- `artagents status`: derives cursor + summarizes plan + active step + recent events.
- `artagents runs ls [--project <slug>]`: file walk of runs/, summarizes by status.
- `artagents author test --fixture <name>`: runs the orchestrator with --dry-run --auto-approve against fixtures/<name>/, diffs events.jsonl against golden/<name>.events.jsonl. (`new`/`check`/`describe`/`compile` shipped in Phase 4.)
- `artagents author explain <orchestrator-id>`: prints natural-language description of the DAG (useful for LLMs verifying their output matches a request).

Phase 1 kernel (events.jsonl + active_run.json + gate above dispatch), Phase 2 step kinds (code/attested/nested), Phase 3 produces+repeat, Phase 4 DSL + author compile/check/describe/new are all shipped. Do NOT implement Stop-hook nudge (Phase 6), CAS (Phase 7), inbox (Phase 8), or golden-run author test runtime (Phase 9). For `author test`, scaffold the verb signature + a basic in-process diff but golden-run capture lives in Phase 9 — the test verb should return a clear "implement Phase 9 to capture golden runs" message if invoked without an existing golden file.

Tests: each verb has its own test file. start writes active_run.json + AGENT.md + run_started event. next prints prohibition preamble verbatim every call. ack rejects bad decisions, validates identity (--agent vs --actor matching ARTAGENTS_ACTOR), runs inline checks, advances/rewinds correctly. abort writes event and clears active_run. status shows correct cursor + recent events. runs ls finds runs across projects. author explain returns a sensible DAG summary. Existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` paths remain unchanged.

User notes and answers:
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-001 three step kinds: Task mode has exactly `code`, `attested`, and `nested` so execution, evidence, and delegation stay distinct.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-002 repeat body attributes: Iteration and fan-out are `repeat.until` and `repeat.for_each` body attributes so they apply uniformly to steps and nested bodies.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-003 plan naming: Runtime uses immutable `plan.json` instead of checklist naming because the structure is a tree with nested bodies and loops.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-004 event hash chain: `events.jsonl` uses plain `sha256(prev_hash + canonical_event_json)` with no HMAC because V1 needs an edit tripwire, not keyed tamper resistance.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-005 no index database: V1 ships without `.index.db` because file walking and grep over `events.jsonl` are adequate until measured otherwise.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-009 code boundary: `code` is deterministic argv, a strict superset of `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}`, may target `artagents executors run <name>`, and must not target `artagents orchestrators run`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-010 nested boundary: Sub-orchestrator delegation is exclusively `nested` so the gate can hash and pin child structure.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-011 gate checks: The gate validates active run presence, plan hash, event chain, and incoming command match before dispatch and prints the exact recovery command on rejection.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-012 gate ordering: The gate runs before `_prepare_project_request()` and `thread_wrapper.begin_orchestrator_run()` so rejected commands create zero project-run side effects.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-019 attestor identity: Agent attestations require `--agent`, human attestations require `--actor` matching `ARTAGENTS_ACTOR`, and self-acks are rejected.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-020 ack rules: `approve` advances, `retry` is only valid after verifier failure, `iterate --feedback` is only valid for `repeat.until=user_approves`, and `abort` ends the run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-021 inline produces checks: Produces inline checks replace verifier substeps while `passes_test` remains a normal `code` step.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-022 semantic checks: `author check` rejects sentinel-only attested outputs because non-trivial artifacts need semantic validation.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-023 stop-hook preamble: Every `artagents next` output includes the prohibition preamble verbatim because repeated injection fights context decay.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-024 additive migration: Existing `OrchestratorDefinition` JSON manifests and `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}` keep working because V1 migration is additive.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-025 honor model: V1 is single-host and honor-based with strong logging because it does not defend against malicious local agents.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-026 cut points: Phase 3 is the frozen-plan runner ship point and Phase 5 is the author-friendly lifecycle ship point.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-027 canonical migration: `artagents/packs/builtin/hype/` is the canonical migration example because it exercises the existing executor pipeline and additive pack layout.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-028 phasing order: V1 implementation follows build phases 1-9 so kernel, step semantics, authoring, lifecycle, nudge, CAS, inbox, and golden tests land in dependency order.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-029 V1 infrastructure limits: V1 excludes daemon, web server, HMAC/keyed crypto, `.index.db`, and shared CAS so the implementation stays file-based, inspectable, and additive.

  "meta_commentary": "Phase 5 is a kernel refactor + 8 new verbs landing on top of solidly tested Phase 1-4 plumbing. The most failure-prone elements are the three significant flags \u2014 implementer should treat them as load-bearing:\\n\\n1. cmd_ack approve command synthesis (FLAG-P5-001): the gate's match_attested_command strips identity flags then literal-compares the remainder to step.command. If you synthesize 'ack --step ...' you'll mismatch every authored command (existing tests use command='review.sh'). Always synthesize step.command + identity/evidence/item tokens.\\n\\n2. Identity validation across all decisions (FLAG-P5-002): retry and iterate skip gate_command and need explicit validate_attested_identity calls. The brief explicitly requires identity validation for all decisions, not just approve.\\n\\n3. peek_current_step (FLAG-P5-003): the auto-traverse loop in gate_command interleaves event APPENDS with re-reads. The refactor introduces an injectable append_fn so peek can pass a list-capturing sink and re-run derive_cursor on (events + captured). 4	
5	import errno
6	import hashlib
7	import json
8	import os
9	from datetime import UTC, datetime
10	from pathlib import Path
11	from typing import Any
12	
13	ZERO_HASH = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
14	
15	
16	class EventLogError(RuntimeError):
17	    """Raised when a task event log cannot be read or written."""
18	
19	
20	def canonical_event_json(event: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
21	    payload = {key: value for key, value in event.items() if key != "hash"}
22	    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
23	
24	
25	def append_event(path: str | Path, event: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
26	    events_path = Path(path)
27	    ok, _last_index, error = verify_chain(events_path)
28	    if not ok:
29	        raise EventLogError(error or f"invalid event hash chain in {events_path}")
30	
31	    previous_events = read_events(events_path)
32	    prev_hash = previous_events[-1]["hash"] if previous_events else ZERO_HASH
33	
34	    stored = dict(event)
35	    stored.pop("hash", None)
36	    stored["hash"] = _event_hash(prev_hash, stored)
37	
38	    events_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
39	    created = not events_path.exists()
40	    try:
41	        with events_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
42	            handle.write(json.dumps(stored, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False))
43	            handle.write("\n")
44	            handle.flush()
45	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
46	        if created:
47	            _fsync_dir(events_path.parent)
48	    except OSError as exc:
49	        raise EventLogError(f"failed to append event to {events_path}: {exc}") from exc
50	    return stored
51	
52	
53	def verify_chain(path: str | Path) -> tuple[bool, int, str | None]:
54	    events_path = Path(path)
55	    try:
56	        handle = events_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8")
57	    except FileNotFoundError:
58	        return True, -1, None
59	    except OSError as exc:
60	        return False, -1, f"failed to read {events_path}: {exc}"
61	
62	    prev_hash = ZERO_HASH
63	    last_index = -1
64	    with handle:
65	        for index, line in enumerate(handle):
66	            if not line.endswith("\n"):
67	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is not newline-terminated"
68	            raw = line[:-1]
69	            if not raw:
70	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is empty"
71	            try:
72	                event = json.loads(raw)
73	            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
74	                return False, index, f"invalid JSON on event log line {index + 1}: {exc.msg}"
75	            if not isinstance(event, dict):
76	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is not an object"
77	            stored_hash = event.get("hash")
78	            if not isinstance(stored_hash, str):
79	                return False, index, f"event log line {index + 1} is missing hash"
80	            expected_hash = _event_hash(prev_hash, event)
81	            if stored_hash != expected_hash:
82	                return (
83	                    False,
84	                    index,
85	                    f"event log line {index + 1} hash mismatch: expected {expected_hash}, got {stored_hash}",
86	                )
87	            prev_hash = stored_hash
88	            last_index = index
89	    return True, last_index, None
90	
91	
92	def read_events(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
93	    events_path = Path(path)
94	    try:
95	        with events_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
96	            return [json.loads(line) for line in handle]
97	    except FileNotFoundError:
98	        return []
99	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
100	        raise EventLogError(f"invalid JSON in {events_path}: {exc.msg}") from exc
101	    except OSError as exc:

335	            raise

127	def derive_cursor(plan: TaskPlan, events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], *, slug: str = "") -> CursorPath:
128	    """Replay ``events.jsonl`` left-to-right to reconstruct the path-stack cursor.
129	
130	    Reconstructible from events alone (supports partial-replay resume):
131	    ``nested_entered`` pushes, ``nested_exited`` pops + advances parent,
132	    ``step_completed`` / ``step_attested`` mark a step advance-eligible iff it
133	    has no produces; otherwise advance is deferred until the contiguous block
134	    contains a ``produces_check_passed`` for every declared produces name.
135	    ``produces_check_failed`` / ``cursor_rewind`` clear pending state without
136	    advancing. ``iteration_started`` pushes an iteration frame; ``iteration_failed``
137	    pops it without advancing the host. ``for_each_expanded`` records the host's
138	    item set on the cursor (used as the source of truth — derive_cursor never
139	    re-reads disk during replay). ``item_started`` pushes a per-item frame;
140	    ``item_completed`` / ``item_attested`` pop the item frame and advance the
141	    host once every item is done. ``step_dispatched`` / ``run_started`` do not
142	    advance.
143	    """
144	    frames: list[_Frame] = [_Frame(plan=plan, path_prefix=(), child_index=0)]
145	    pending: list[set[str] | None] = [None]
146	    for_each_progress: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
147	    pinned_failure: tuple[str, str] | None = None
148	    for event in events:
149	        kind = event.get("kind")
150	        if kind == "iteration_exhausted":
151	            on_exhaust = event.get("on_exhaust")
152	            host_path = _path_str_from_event(event)
153	            if on_exhaust == "fail":
154	                pinned_failure = ("repeat.until max_iterations exhausted", host_path)
155	                continue
156	            if on_exhaust == "escalate":
157	                top = frames[-1]
158	                if top.child_index < len(top.plan.steps):
159	                    host_step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
160	                    override_plan = TaskPlan(
161	                        plan_id=f"__exhaust_{host_step.id}",
162	                        version=1,
163	                        steps=(_make_exhaust_override_step(slug, host_path),),
164	                    )
165	                    frames.append(
166	                        _Frame(
167	                            plan=override_plan,
168	                            path_prefix=top.path_prefix + (host_step.id,),
169	                            child_index=0,
170	                            repeat_step_id=host_step.id,
171	                        )
172	                    )
173	                    pending.append(None)
174	            continue
175	        if kind == "nested_entered":
176	            top = frames[-1]
177	            if top.child_index >= len(top.plan.steps):
178	                raise TaskRunGateError(
179	                    reason="nested_entered points past end of frame",
180	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
181	                )
182	            step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
183	            if not isinstance(step, NestedStep):
184	                raise TaskRunGateError(
185	                    reason="nested_entered did not land on a NestedStep",
186	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
187	                )
188	            frames.append(
189	                _Frame(
190	                    plan=step.plan,
191	                    path_prefix=top.path_prefix + (step.id,),
192	                    child_index=0,
193	                )
194	            )
195	            pending.append(None)
196	        elif kind == "nested_exited":
197	            if len(frames) <= 1:
198	                raise TaskRunGateError(
199	                    reason="nested_exited at root frame",
200	                    recovery="inspect events.jsonl",
201	                )
202	            frames.pop()
203	            pending.pop()
204	            frames[-1].child_index += 1
205	            pending[-1] = None
206	        elif kind == "iteration_started":
207	            top = frames[-1]
208	            if top.child_index >= len(top.plan.steps):
209	                continue
210	            host_step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
211	            iteration = int(event.get("iteration", 1))
212	            frames.append(_make_iteration_frame(host_step, top.path_prefix, iteration))
213	            pending.append(None)
214	        elif kind == "iteration_failed":
215	            if frames[-1].repeat_step_id is None:
216	                continue
217	            frames.pop()
218	            pending.pop()
219	            pending[-1] = None
220	        elif kind == "for_each_expanded":
221	            host_path = _path_str_from_event(event)
222	            items = tuple(event.get("item_ids") or ())
223	            for_each_progress.setdefault(host_path, {"items": items, "completed": set()})
224	            for_each_progress[host_path]["items"] = items
225	        elif kind == "item_started":
226	            top = frames[-1]
227	            if top.child_index >= len(top.plan.steps):
228	                continue
229	            host_step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
230	            item_id = event.get("item_id")
231	            if not isinstance(item_id, str):
232	                continue
233	            frames.append(_make_item_frame(host_step, top.path_prefix, item_id))
234	            pending.append(None)
235	        elif kind in ("item_completed", "item_attested"):
236	            host_path = _path_str_from_event(event)
237	            item_id = event.get("item_id")
238	            if not isinstance(item_id, str):
239	                continue
240	            entry = for_each_progress.setdefault(host_path, {"items": (), "completed": set()})
241	            entry["completed"].add(item_id)
242	            if frames[-1].item_id == item_id:
243	                frames.pop()
244	                pending.pop()
245	                pending[-1] = None
246	            # If all items now completed and the host's parent frame is on top, advance host.
247	            if entry["items"] and set(entry["items"]) <= entry["completed"]:
248	                host_segments = host_path.split(STEP_PATH_SEP) if host_path else []
249	                expected_parent_prefix = tuple(host_segments[:-1])
250	                if tuple(frames[-1].path_prefix) == expected_parent_prefix:
251	                    if frames[-1].child_index < len(frames[-1].plan.steps):
252	                        candidate = frames[-1].plan.steps[frames[-1].child_index]
253	                        if host_segments and candidate.id == host_segments[-1]:
254	                            frames[-1].child_index += 1
255	                            pending[-1] = None
256	        elif kind in ("step_completed", "step_attested"):
257	            top = frames[-1]
258	            if top.child_index >= len(top.plan.steps):
259	                continue
260	            step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
261	            produces = getattr(step, "produces", ())
262	            if not produces:
263	                top.child_index += 1
264	                pending[-1] = None
265	            else:
266	                pending[-1] = {entry.name for entry in produces}
267	        elif kind == "produces_check_passed":
268	            current = pending[-1]
269	            if current is not None:
270	                name = event.get("produces_name")
271	                current.discard(name)
272	                if not current:
273	                    frames[-1].child_index += 1
274	                    pending[-1] = None
275	        elif kind in ("produces_check_failed", "cursor_rewind"):
276	            pending[-1] = None
277	        elif kind == "step_dispatched":
278	            pending[-1] = None
279	        # run_started / iteration_exhausted: no-op for cursor
280	    _finalize_cursor(frames, pending, for_each_progress)
281	    return CursorPath(frames=frames, for_each_progress=for_each_progress, pinned_failure=pinned_failure)

308	def _finalize_cursor(
309	    frames: list[_Frame],
310	    pending: list[set[str] | None],
311	    for_each_progress: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
312	) -> None:
313	    """Pop exhausted iteration/item frames after event replay.
314	
315	    For verifier_passes / approve cases, the iteration frame ends with
316	    ``produces_check_passed`` coverage or ``step_attested`` (no following
317	    iteration_failed) — the iter frame's child_index is at end-of-plan.
318	    Pop it and advance the host. Same for item frames whose item is in
319	    the for_each_progress.completed set.
320	    """
321	    while True:
322	        top = frames[-1]
323	        if top.repeat_step_id is None:
324	            break
325	        if top.child_index < len(top.plan.steps):
326	            break
327	        if top.item_id is not None:
328	            host_path_segments = top.path_prefix + (top.repeat_step_id,)
329	            host_path = STEP_PATH_SEP.join(host_path_segments)
330	            entry = for_each_progress.get(host_path)
331	            frames.pop()
332	            pending.pop()
333	            pending[-1] = None
334	            if entry is not None and entry["items"] and set(entry["items"]) <= entry["completed"]:
335	                frames[-1].child_index += 1
336	                pending[-1] = None
337	        else:
338	            frames.pop()
339	            pending.pop()
340	            frames[-1].child_index += 1
341	            pending[-1] = None

352	def gate_command(
353	    slug: str,
354	    command: str,
355	    argv: Sequence[str],
356	    *,
357	    root: str | Path | None = None,
358	    reentry: bool = False,
359	) -> GateDecision:
360	    active_run = read_active_run(slug, root=root)
361	    if active_run is None:
362	        if not is_in_task_run(slug):
363	            return GateDecision(active=False)
364	        _reject(slug, "active_run.json is missing", abort=True)
365	
366	    project_root = project_dir(slug, root=root)
367	    plan_path = project_root / "plan.json"
368	    plan_hash = compute_plan_hash(plan_path)
369	    if plan_hash != active_run["plan_hash"]:
370	        _reject(slug, "plan.json hash does not match active_run.json pin", abort=True)
371	
372	    run_id = active_run["run_id"]
373	    events_path = project_root / "runs" / run_id / "events.jsonl"
374	    ok, _last_index, error = verify_chain(events_path)
375	    if not ok:
376	        _reject(slug, error or "events.jsonl chain integrity check failed", abort=True)
377	
378	    plan = load_plan(plan_path)

381	    if cursor.pinned_failure is not None:

383	        raise TaskRunGateError(reason=reason, recovery=f"artagents abort --project {slug}")
384	    run_started_actor = _find_run_started_actor(events)
385	
386	    # Auto-traverse: nested_entered/exited for nested plans; iteration_started/
387	    # for_each_expanded/item_started for repeat hosts. We loop until we land on a
388	    # dispatchable leaf (CodeStep or AttestedStep) inside the appropriate frame.
389	    while True:
390	        if cursor.at_root_done:
391	            _reject(slug, "plan is exhausted", abort=True)
392	        if cursor.top_exhausted:
393	            top = cursor.frames[-1]

400	            append_event(events_path, make_nested_exited_event(exit_path_str, 0))

402	            cursor.frames[-1].child_index += 1
403	            continue
404	        top = cursor.frames[-1]
405	        current_step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
406	        current_path = top.path_prefix + (current_step.id,)
407	        path_str = STEP_PATH_SEP.join(current_path)
408	        repeat = getattr(current_step, "repeat", None)
409	        in_repeat_frame = top.repeat_step_id is not None
410	        if repeat is not None and not in_repeat_frame:
411	            if isinstance(repeat, RepeatUntil):
412	                _enter_repeat_until(
413	                    slug=slug,
414	                    cursor=cursor,
415	                    host=current_step,
416	                    repeat=repeat,
417	                    path_str=path_str,
418	                    parent_prefix=top.path_prefix,
419	                    events=events,
420	                    events_path=events_path,
421	                )
422	                # Refresh local references.
423	                events = read_events(events_path)
424	                top = cursor.frames[-1]
425	                current_step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
426	                current_path = top.path_prefix + (current_step.id,)
427	                path_str = STEP_PATH_SEP.join(current_path)
428	                continue
429	            if isinstance(repeat, RepeatForEach):
430	                next_item_id = _enter_repeat_for_each(
431	                    slug=slug,
432	                    cursor=cursor,
433	                    host=current_step,
434	                    repeat=repeat,
435	                    path_str=path_str,
436	                    parent_prefix=top.path_prefix,
437	                    events=events,
438	                    events_path=events_path,
439	                    project_root=project_root,
440	                    run_id=run_id,
441	                    incoming_command=command,
442	                )
443	                events = read_events(events_path)
444	                top = cursor.frames[-1]
445	                current_step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
446	                current_path = top.path_prefix + (current_step.id,)
447	                path_str = STEP_PATH_SEP.join(current_path)
448	                continue
449	        if isinstance(current_step, NestedStep):

459	    item_id = top.item_id if top.repeat_step_id is not None else None
460	
461	    if isinstance(current_step, CodeStep):

525	        ack=AckRule(kind="actor"),
526	    )

529	def _enter_repeat_until(
530	    *,
531	    slug: str,
532	    cursor: CursorPath,
533	    host: Any,
534	    repeat: RepeatUntil,
535	    path_str: str,
536	    parent_prefix: tuple[str, ...],
537	    events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],
538	    events_path: Path,
539	) -> None:
540	    failed = _count_iteration_failed(events, path_str)
541	    iteration = failed + 1
542	    path_tuple = parent_prefix + (host.id,)
543	    if iteration > repeat.max_iterations:
544	        existing = _has_iteration_exhausted(events, path_str)
545	        if existing is None:
546	            append_event(
547	                events_path,
548	                make_iteration_exhausted_event(
549	                    path_tuple,
550	                    on_exhaust=repeat.on_exhaust,
551	                    max_iterations=repeat.max_iterations,
552	                ),
553	            )
554	        if repeat.on_exhaust == "fail":
555	            raise TaskRunGateError(
556	                reason="repeat.until max_iterations exhausted",
557	                recovery=f"artagents abort --project {slug}",
558	            )
559	        # escalate: park on a synthetic exhaust-override attested step.
560	        override_step = _make_exhaust_override_step(slug, path_str)
561	        override_plan = TaskPlan(
562	            plan_id=f"__exhaust_{host.id}",
563	            version=1,
564	            steps=(override_step,),
565	        )
566	        cursor.frames.append(
567	            _Frame(
568	                plan=override_plan,
569	                path_prefix=path_tuple,
570	                child_index=0,
571	                repeat_step_id=host.id,
572	            )
573	        )
574	        return
575	    append_event(events_path, make_iteration_started_event(path_tuple, iteration))
576	    cursor.frames.append(_make_iteration_frame(host, parent_prefix, iteration))

579	def _resolve_for_each_items(
580	    *,
581	    slug: str,
582	    repeat: RepeatForEach,
583	    project_root: Path,
584	    run_id: str,
585	) -> tuple[str, ...]:
586	    if repeat.items_source == "static":
587	        items = repeat.items
588	    else:
589	        target_id, produces_name = parse_from_ref(repeat.from_ref or "")
590	        prior_step_dir = step_dir_for_path(slug, run_id, (target_id,), root=project_root.parent)
591	        # Find the prior step's declared produces path. We need the plan for that.
592	        # We re-load plan.json which is allowed at gate_command (not in derive_cursor).
593	        plan = load_plan(project_root / "plan.json")
594	        target_step = next((s for s in plan.steps if s.id == target_id), None)
595	        if target_step is None:
596	            raise TaskRunGateError(
597	                reason=f"for_each.from references unknown sibling step {target_id!r}",
598	                recovery=f"artagents abort --project {slug}",
599	            )
600	        produces_entry = next((p for p in target_step.produces if p.name == produces_name), None)
601	        if produces_entry is None:
602	            raise TaskRunGateError(
603	                reason=f"for_each.from references unknown produces {produces_name!r}",
604	                recovery=f"artagents abort --project {slug}",
605	            )
606	        try:
607	            payload = json.loads((prior_step_dir / produces_entry.path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
608	        except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as exc:
609	            raise TaskRunGateError(
610	                reason=f"for_each.from cannot read produces JSON: {exc}",
611	                recovery=f"artagents abort --project {slug}",
612	            ) from exc
613	        if not isinstance(payload, list):
614	            raise TaskRunGateError(reason="for_each items must be unique strings", recovery=f"artagents next --project {slug}")
615	        items = tuple(payload)
616	    if not all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in items):
617	        raise TaskRunGateError(reason="for_each items must be unique strings", recovery=f"artagents next --project {slug}")
618	    if len(set(items)) != len(items):
619	        raise TaskRunGateError(reason="for_each items must be unique strings", recovery=f"artagents next --project {slug}")
620	    return items
621

623	def _enter_repeat_for_each(
624	    *,
625	    slug: str,
626	    cursor: CursorPath,
627	    host: Any,
628	    repeat: RepeatForEach,
629	    path_str: str,
630	    parent_prefix: tuple[str, ...],
631	    events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],
632	    events_path: Path,
633	    project_root: Path,
634	    run_id: str,
635	    incoming_command: str,
636	) -> str | None:
637	    # FLAG-P3-004: scan events for an existing for_each_expanded; if absent, append once.
638	    existing = next(
639	        (
640	            ev
641	            for ev in events
642	            if isinstance(ev, dict)
643	            and ev.get("kind") == "for_each_expanded"
644	            and _path_str_from_event(ev) == path_str
645	        ),
646	        None,
647	    )
648	    if existing is None:
649	        items = _resolve_for_each_items(slug=slug, repeat=repeat, project_root=project_root, run_id=run_id)
650	        path_tuple = parent_prefix + (host.id,)
651	        append_event(events_path, make_for_each_expanded_event(path_tuple, items))
652	        cursor.for_each_progress[path_str] = {"items": items, "completed": set()}
653	    else:
654	        items = tuple(existing.get("item_ids") or ())
655	    progress = cursor.for_each_progress.setdefault(path_str, {"items": items, "completed": set()})
656	    completed = progress["completed"]
657	    # For attested host: the incoming command may target a specific item via --item.
658	    target_item: str | None = None
659	    if isinstance(host, AttestedStep):
660	        _, args = match_attested_command(incoming_command, host.command)
661	        if args.item is not None:
662	            target_item = args.item
663	    if target_item is None:
664	        # Pick first not-yet-completed item.
665	        target_item = next((it for it in items if it not in completed), None)
666	    if target_item is None:
667	        # All items done — finalize will pop. Just return.
668	        return None
669	    if target_item not in items:
670	        _reject(slug, f"for_each --item {target_item!r} not in expanded item set", abort=False)
671	    if target_item in completed:
672	        _reject(slug, f"for_each --item {target_item!r} already completed", abort=False)
673	    path_tuple = parent_prefix + (host.id,)
674	    append_event(events_path, make_item_started_event(path_tuple, target_item))
675	    cursor.frames.append(_make_item_frame(host, parent_prefix, target_item))
676	    return target_item

679	def _dispatch_code(
680	    *,
681	    slug: str,
682	    command: str,
683	    step: CodeStep,
684	    path_str: str,
685	    path_tuple: tuple[str, ...],
686	    events_path: Path,
687	    run_id: str,
688	    reentry: bool,
689	    project_root: Path,
690	    iteration: int | None = None,
691	    item_id: str | None = None,
692	) -> GateDecision:
693	    if command != step.command:
694	        _reject(slug, "incoming command does not match plan[cursor]", abort=False)
695	
696	    if reentry:
697	        # FLAG-P3-005: scan back to the latest event for THIS plan_step_id rather than events[-1];
698	        # produces_check_failed must permit redispatch (cursor hasn't advanced).
699	        events = read_events(events_path)
700	        latest = _latest_event_for_step(events, path_str)
701	        if (
702	            isinstance(latest, dict)
703	            and latest.get("kind") == "step_dispatched"
704	            and latest.get("command") == command
705	        ):
706	            apply_task_run_env(run_id, slug, path_str, item_id=item_id, iteration=iteration)
707	            return _code_decision(
708	                run_id=run_id,
709	                slug=slug,
710	                path_str=path_str,
711	                path_tuple=path_tuple,
712	                events_path=events_path,
713	                produces=step.produces,
714	                project_root=project_root,
715	                reentry=True,
716	                iteration=iteration,
717	                item_id=item_id,
718	            )
719	        if isinstance(latest, dict) and latest.get("kind") == "produces_check_failed":
720	            append_event(events_path, make_step_dispatched_event(path_str, command))
721	            apply_task_run_env(run_id, slug, path_str, item_id=item_id, iteration=iteration)
722	            return _code_decision(
723	                run_id=run_id,
724	                slug=slug,
725	                path_str=path_str,
726	                path_tuple=path_tuple,
727	                events_path=events_path,
728	                produces=step.produces,
729	                project_root=project_root,
730	                reentry=False,
731	                iteration=iteration,
732	                item_id=item_id,
733	            )
734	        _reject(slug, "incoming command does not match plan[cursor]", abort=False)
735	
736	    append_event(events_path, make_step_dispatched_event(path_str, command))
737	    apply_task_run_env(run_id, slug, path_str, item_id=item_id, iteration=iteration)
738	    return _code_decision(
739	        run_id=run_id,
740	        slug=slug,
741	        path_str=path_str,
742	        path_tuple=path_tuple,
743	        events_path=events_path,
744	        produces=step.produces,
745	        project_root=project_root,
746	        reentry=False,
747	        iteration=iteration,
748	        item_id=item_id,
749	    )

781	def _latest_event_for_step(events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], path_str: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
782	    path_list = path_str.split(STEP_PATH_SEP)
783	    for ev in reversed(events):
784	        if not isinstance(ev, dict):
785	            continue
786	        if ev.get("plan_step_id") == path_str:
787	            return ev
788	        if ev.get("plan_step_path") == path_list:
789	            return ev
790	    return None

793	def _dispatch_attested(
794	    *,
795	    slug: str,
796	    command: str,
797	    step: AttestedStep,
798	    path_str: str,
799	    path_tuple: tuple[str, ...],
800	    events_path: Path,
801	    run_id: str,

803	    project_root: Path,

805	    item_id: str | None = None,

807	    matched, args = match_attested_command(command, step.command)
808	    if not matched:

810	
811	    attestor_kind, attestor_id = _validate_attested_identity(
812	        slug=slug,

818	    if item_id is not None:

825	                attestor_id=attestor_id,
826	                evidence=args.evidence,
827	            ),
828	        )
829	    else:
830	        append_event(
831	            events_path,
832	            make_step_attested_event(path_str, attestor_kind, attestor_id, args.evidence),
833	        )
834	    decision = GateDecision(
835	        active=True,
836	        run_id=run_id,
837	        plan_step_id=path_str,
838	        events_path=events_path,
839	        reentry=False,
840	        step_kind="attested",
841	        slug=slug,
842	        plan_step_path=path_tuple,
843	        produces=step.produces,
844	        project_root=project_root,
845	        iteration=iteration,
846	        item_id=item_id,
847	    )
848	    if step.produces:
849	        _run_inline_checks(decision, step.produces)
850	    if iteration is not None:
851	        feedback = _extract_iterate_feedback(args.evidence)
852	        if feedback is not None:
853	            _write_iteration_feedback(decision, feedback)
854	            append_event(
855	                events_path,
856	                make_iteration_failed_event(
857	                    path_tuple,
858	                    iteration,
859	                    reason="iterate_feedback",
860	                ),
861	            )
862	    return decision

872	def _write_iteration_feedback(decision: GateDecision, feedback: str) -> None:
873	    if (
874	        decision.slug is None
875	        or decision.run_id is None
876	        or decision.iteration is None
877	        or decision.project_root is None
878	        or not decision.plan_step_path
879	    ):
880	        return
881	    iter_dir = step_dir_for_path(
882	        decision.slug,
883	        decision.run_id,
884	        decision.plan_step_path,
885	        iteration=decision.iteration,
886	        root=decision.project_root.parent,
887	    )
888	    iter_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
889	    feedback_path = iter_dir / "feedback.json"
890	    cumulative: list[str] = []
891	    if decision.iteration > 1:
892	        prev_dir = step_dir_for_path(
893	            decision.slug,
894	            decision.run_id,
895	            decision.plan_step_path,
896	            iteration=decision.iteration - 1,
897	            root=decision.project_root.parent,
898	        )
899	        prev_path = prev_dir / "feedback.json"
900	        if prev_path.exists():
901	            try:
902	                prev = json.loads(prev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
903	                if isinstance(prev, list):
904	                    cumulative = [str(x) for x in prev]
905	            except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
906	                cumulative = []
907	    cumulative.append(feedback)
908	    feedback_path.write_text(
909	        json.dumps(cumulative, ensure_ascii=False),
910	        encoding="utf-8",
911	    )

914	def match_attested_command(incoming: str, expected_prefix: str) -> tuple[bool, AttestedArgs]:
915	    """Strip ``--agent``/``--actor``/``--evidence``/``--item`` (repeatable evidence)
916	    tokens from ``incoming`` and compare the canonical remainder to ``expected_prefix``.
917	    """
918	    try:
919	        tokens = shlex.split(incoming)
920	    except ValueError:
921	        return False, AttestedArgs(agent=None, actor=None, evidence=())
922	    agent: str | None = None
923	    actor: str | None = None
924	    item: str | None = None
925	    evidence: list[str] = []
926	    remaining: list[str] = []
927	    i = 0
928	    while i < len(tokens):
929	        token = tokens[i]
930	        if token == "--agent" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
931	            agent = tokens[i + 1]
932	            i += 2
933	            continue
934	        if token == "--actor" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
935	            actor = tokens[i + 1]
936	            i += 2
937	            continue
938	        if token == "--item" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
939	            item = tokens[i + 1]
940	            i += 2
941	            continue
942	        if token == "--evidence" and i + 1 < len(tokens):
943	            evidence.append(tokens[i + 1])
944	            i += 2
945	            continue
946	        remaining.append(token)
947	        i += 1
948	    rejoined = " ".join(shlex.quote(token) for token in remaining)
949	    matched = rejoined == expected_prefix
950	    return matched, AttestedArgs(agent=agent, actor=actor, evidence=tuple(evidence), item=item)
951	
952	
953	def _validate_attested_identity(
954	    *,
955	    slug: str,
956	    step: AttestedStep,
957	    args: AttestedArgs,
958	    run_started_actor: str | None,
959	) -> tuple[str, str]:
960	    if args.agent is None and args.actor is None:
961	        _reject(slug, "attested step requires --agent or --actor", abort=False)
962	    if args.agent is not None and args.actor is not None:
963	        _reject(slug, "attested step rejects both --agent and --actor", abort=False)
964	    if step.ack.kind == "agent":
965	        if args.agent is None:
966	            _reject(slug, "attested step ack.kind=agent requires --agent", abort=False)
967	        return "agent", args.agent  # type: ignore[return-value]
968	    # ack.kind == "actor"
969	    if args.actor is None:
970	        _reject(slug, "attested step ack.kind=actor requires --actor", abort=False)
971	    if task_actor_env() != args.actor:
972	        _reject(slug, "attested --actor does not match ARTAGENTS_ACTOR env", abort=False)
973	    # FLAG-005: self-ack rejection only applies to actor attestations because agents
974	    # do not start runs in V1; an agent_id on run_started would be required to
975	    # symmetrically block agent self-acks, which is out of scope for Phase 2.
976	    if (
977	        run_started_actor is not None
978	        and run_started_actor == args.actor
979	        and task_actor_env() == args.actor
980	    ):
981	        _reject(slug, "self-ack rejected", abort=False)
982	    return "actor", args.actor  # type: ignore[return-value]
983

985	def record_dispatch_complete(decision: GateDecision, returncode: int) -> None:
986	    if not decision.active or decision.events_path is None or decision.plan_step_id is None:
987	        return
988	    if decision.step_kind == "attested":
989	        # attested steps are advanced by step_attested itself; do not double-emit
990	        return
991	    append_event(
992	        decision.events_path,
993	        make_step_completed_event(decision.plan_step_id, returncode),
994	    )
995	    if decision.produces:
996	        _run_inline_checks(decision, decision.produces)

999	# step_dir_for_path is the ONLY directory API used in this gate path (FLAG-P3-001).
1000	def _run_inline_checks(decision: GateDecision, produces: tuple[ProducesEntry, ...]) -> bool:
1001	    if (
1002	        decision.events_path is None
1003	        or decision.run_id is None
1004	        or decision.slug is None
1005	        or decision.project_root is None
1006	        or not decision.plan_step_path
1007	    ):
1008	        return True
1009	    projects_root = decision.project_root.parent
1010	    step_dir = step_dir_for_path(
1011	        decision.slug,
1012	        decision.run_id,
1013	        decision.plan_step_path,
1014	        iteration=decision.iteration,
1015	        item_id=decision.item_id,
1016	        root=projects_root,
1017	    )
1018	    for entry in produces:
1019	        artifact_path = step_dir / entry.path
1020	        result = entry.check.run(artifact_path)
1021	        if not result.ok:
1022	            append_event(
1023	                decision.events_path,
1024	                make_produces_check_failed_event(
1025	                    decision.plan_step_path,
1026	                    entry.name,
1027	                    check_id=entry.check.check_id,
1028	                    reason=result.reason,
1029	                ),
1030	            )
1031	            if decision.iteration is not None:
1032	                append_event(
1033	                    decision.events_path,
1034	                    make_iteration_failed_event(
1035	                        decision.plan_step_path,
1036	                        decision.iteration,
1037	                        reason=f"produces check failed: {entry.name}",
1038	                    ),
1039	                )
1040	            else:
1041	                append_event(
1042	                    decision.events_path,
1043	                    make_cursor_rewind_event(
1044	                        decision.plan_step_path,
1045	                        reason=f"produces check failed: {entry.name}",
1046	                    ),
1047	                )
1048	            return False
1049	        append_event(
1050	            decision.events_path,
1051	            make_produces_check_passed_event(
1052	                decision.plan_step_path,
1053	                entry.name,
1054	                check_id=entry.check.check_id,
1055	            ),
1056	        )
1057	    return True

1095	def command_for_argv(argv: Sequence[str]) -> str:
1096	    tokens = [str(token) for token in argv]
1097	    if len(tokens) >= 3 and Path(tokens[0]).name.startswith("python") and tokens[1:3] == ["-m", "artagents"]:
1098	        tokens = tokens[3:]
1099	    elif tokens and Path(tokens[0]).name.endswith("artagents"):
1100	        tokens = tokens[1:]
1101	    return " ".join(shlex.quote(token) for token in tokens)

1104	def _compute_inline_plan_hash(plan: TaskPlan) -> str:
1105	    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical_event_json(plan.to_dict()).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
1106	    return f"sha256:{digest}"

        Idea:
Implement Phase 5 (Lifecycle verbs split by audience) of the ArtAgents orchestrator V1 design per docs/orchestrator-v1-plan.md section 8. Phase 5 scope: introduce three audience-scoped verb groups under the top-level CLI:

  artagents next | ack | status | abort               (agent-facing, mid-run)
  artagents start | abort | status | runs ls          (operator)
  artagents author new | check | describe | test | compile | explain   (author; new/check/describe/compile already shipped in Phase 4)

Wire them into artagents/pipeline.py via subcommands. The agent-facing verbs and operator verbs should NOT collide with existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` (which stays). Specifically:

- `artagents start <orchestrator-id> --project <slug> [--name "..."]`: materializes the plan from compiled JSON, hashes it, writes active_run.json, appends run_started to events.jsonl, writes AGENT.md as the contract for whoever's driving.
- `artagents next`: reads active_run.json, derives cursor from events.jsonl (Phase 1 kernel API), prints next legal command/instruction with the prohibition preamble verbatim every call (so Stop hooks re-inject context). For code steps prints the exact argv to run; for attested prints instructions + ack template. For repeat:until iterations and repeat:for_each items, prints cumulative feedback / item ledger.
- `artagents ack <step> --decision {approve,retry,iterate,abort} [--evidence path] [--agent id | --actor name] [--feedback "..."] [--item id]`: validates ack against current step + decision rules (retry only after verifier failure; iterate only when repeat.until=user_approves), appends ack event, runs inline produces checks where applicable, advances cursor or rewinds.
- `artagents abort`: ends the run, writes run_aborted event, removes active_run.json.
- `artagents status`: derives cursor + summarizes plan + active step + recent events.
- `artagents runs ls [--project <slug>]`: file walk of runs/, summarizes by status.
- `artagents author test --fixture <name>`: runs the orchestrator with --dry-run --auto-approve against fixtures/<name>/, diffs events.jsonl against golden/<name>.events.jsonl. (`new`/`check`/`describe`/`compile` shipped in Phase 4.)
- `artagents author explain <orchestrator-id>`: prints natural-language description of the DAG (useful for LLMs verifying their output matches a request).

Phase 1 kernel (events.jsonl + active_run.json + gate above dispatch), Phase 2 step kinds (code/attested/nested), Phase 3 produces+repeat, Phase 4 DSL + author compile/check/describe/new are all shipped. Do NOT implement Stop-hook nudge (Phase 6), CAS (Phase 7), inbox (Phase 8), or golden-run author test runtime (Phase 9). For `author test`, scaffold the verb signature + a basic in-process diff but golden-run capture lives in Phase 9 — the test verb should return a clear "implement Phase 9 to capture golden runs" message if invoked without an existing golden file.

Tests: each verb has its own test file. start writes active_run.json + AGENT.md + run_started event. next prints prohibition preamble verbatim every call. ack rejects bad decisions, validates identity (--agent vs --actor matching ARTAGENTS_ACTOR), runs inline checks, advances/rewinds correctly. abort writes event and clears active_run. status shows correct cursor + recent events. runs ls finds runs across projects. author explain returns a sensible DAG summary. Existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` paths remain unchanged.

User notes and answers:
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-001 three step kinds: Task mode has exactly `code`, `attested`, and `nested` so execution, evidence, and delegation stay distinct.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-002 repeat body attributes: Iteration and fan-out are `repeat.until` and `repeat.for_each` body attributes so they apply uniformly to steps and nested bodies.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-003 plan naming: Runtime uses immutable `plan.json` instead of checklist naming because the structure is a tree with nested bodies and loops.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-004 event hash chain: `events.jsonl` uses plain `sha256(prev_hash + canonical_event_json)` with no HMAC because V1 needs an edit tripwire, not keyed tamper resistance.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-005 no index database: V1 ships without `.index.db` because file walking and grep over `events.jsonl` are adequate until measured otherwise.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-009 code boundary: `code` is deterministic argv, a strict superset of `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}`, may target `artagents executors run <name>`, and must not target `artagents orchestrators run`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-010 nested boundary: Sub-orchestrator delegation is exclusively `nested` so the gate can hash and pin child structure.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-011 gate checks: The gate validates active run presence, plan hash, event chain, and incoming command match before dispatch and prints the exact recovery command on rejection.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-012 gate ordering: The gate runs before `_prepare_project_request()` and `thread_wrapper.begin_orchestrator_run()` so rejected commands create zero project-run side effects.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-019 attestor identity: Agent attestations require `--agent`, human attestations require `--actor` matching `ARTAGENTS_ACTOR`, and self-acks are rejected.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-020 ack rules: `approve` advances, `retry` is only valid after verifier failure, `iterate --feedback` is only valid for `repeat.until=user_approves`, and `abort` ends the run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-021 inline produces checks: Produces inline checks replace verifier substeps while `passes_test` remains a normal `code` step.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-022 semantic checks: `author check` rejects sentinel-only attested outputs because non-trivial artifacts need semantic validation.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-023 stop-hook preamble: Every `artagents next` output includes the prohibition preamble verbatim because repeated injection fights context decay.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-024 additive migration: Existing `OrchestratorDefinition` JSON manifests and `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}` keep working because V1 migration is additive.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-025 honor model: V1 is single-host and honor-based with strong logging because it does not defend against malicious local agents.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-026 cut points: Phase 3 is the frozen-plan runner ship point and Phase 5 is the author-friendly lifecycle ship point.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-027 canonical migration: `artagents/packs/builtin/hype/` is the canonical migration example because it exercises the existing executor pipeline and additive pack layout.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-028 phasing order: V1 implementation follows build phases 1-9 so kernel, step semantics, authoring, lifecycle, nudge, CAS, inbox, and golden tests land in dependency order.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-029 V1 infrastructure limits: V1 excludes daemon, web server, HMAC/keyed crypto, `.index.db`, and shared CAS so the implementation stays file-based, inspectable, and additive.

353	    *,

361	    raise_on_exhausted: bool,
362	) -> tuple[Any, tuple[str, ...]] | None:
363	    """Walk the cursor through nested entries and repeat-host expansions until we
364	    land on a CodeStep / AttestedStep leaf. Mutates ``cursor.frames`` and pushes
365	    auto-traversal events through ``append_fn``. ``events_view`` must be the list
366	    that ``append_fn`` extends (or that mirrors the on-disk log) so the helpers
367	    that scan prior events (``_count_iteration_failed``, the ``for_each_expanded``
368	    lookup) see the latest state.
369	
370	    With ``raise_on_exhausted=True`` (gate dispatch) the helper raises
371	    ``TaskRunGateError`` when the plan is exhausted; with ``False`` (peek) it
372	    returns ``None`` so the caller can report exhaustion to the operator.
373	    """
374	    while True:
375	        if cursor.at_root_done:
376	            if raise_on_exhausted:
377	                _reject(slug, "plan is exhausted", abort=True)

388	            cursor.frames.pop()
389	            cursor.frames[-1].child_index += 1
390	            continue
391	        top = cursor.frames[-1]
392	        current_step = top.plan.steps[top.child_index]
393	        current_path = top.path_prefix + (current_step.id,)
394	        path_str = STEP_PATH_SEP.join(current_path)
395	        repeat = getattr(current_step, "repeat", None)
396	        in_repeat_frame = top.repeat_step_id is not None
397	        if repeat is not None and not in_repeat_frame:
398	            if isinstance(repeat, RepeatUntil):
399	                _enter_repeat_until(
400	                    slug=slug,
401	                    cursor=cursor,
402	                    host=current_step,
403	                    repeat=repeat,
404	                    path_str=path_str,
405	                    parent_prefix=top.path_prefix,
406	                    events=events_view,
407	                    append_fn=append_fn,
408	                )
409	                continue
410	            if isinstance(repeat, RepeatForEach):
411	                _enter_repeat_for_each(
412	                    slug=slug,
413	                    cursor=cursor,
414	                    host=current_step,
415	                    repeat=repeat,
416	                    path_str=path_str,
417	                    parent_prefix=top.path_prefix,
418	                    events=events_view,
419	                    append_fn=append_fn,
420	                    project_root=project_root,

  "new_string": "@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass PeekResult:\n    \"\"\"Read-only view of the next dispatchable step under the current cursor.\n\n    Returned by ``peek_current_step`` for ``cmd_next`` / ``cmd_status`` /\n    ``cmd_ack`` to inspect what the gate would dispatch on next without\n    actually mutating ``events.jsonl``. ``exhausted=True`` covers both\n    ``at_root_done`` (plan complete) and ``pinned_failure``\n    (repeat.until on_exhaust=fail).\n    \"\"\"\n\n    step: Any\n    path_tuple: tuple[str, ...]\n    iteration: int | None\n    item_id: str | None\n    exhausted: bool\n\n\ndef peek_current_step(\n    plan: TaskPlan,\n    events: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],\n    slug: str,\n    *,\n    project_root: Path,\n    run_id: str,\n) -> PeekResult:\n    \"\"\"Walk the cursor exactly the way the gate would, but with a list-capturing\n    ``append_fn`` so ``events.jsonl`` is never mutated.\n\n    Shares ``_auto_traverse_to_leaf`` with ``gate_command`` so peek and dispatch\n    cannot drift on iteration / for_each / nested transitions (FLAG-P5-003).\n    The captured events are kept in ``events_view`` so prior-event scans inside\n    the auto-traverse helpers (``_count_iteration_failed``, the\n    ``for_each_expanded`` lookup) see them; after every append we let the helper\n    proceed and re-evaluate the cursor — which is equivalent to recomputing\n    ``derive_cursor(plan, events + captured, slug=slug)`` because the helper\n    performs the same frame mutations that ``derive_cursor`` would on replay.\n    \"\"\"\n    cursor = derive_cursor(plan, events, slug=slug)\n    if cursor.pinned_failure is not None or cursor.at_root_done:\n        return PeekResult(step=None, path_tuple=(), iteration=None, item_id=None, exhausted=True)\n\n    events_view = list(events)\n    captured: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n\n    def _peek_append(ev: dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n        captured.append(ev)\n        events_view.append(ev)\n\n    leaf = _auto_traverse_to_leaf(\n        slug=slug,\n        cursor=cursor,\n        events_view=events_view,\n        incoming_command=\"\",\n        project_root=project_root,\n        run_id=run_id,\n        append_fn=_peek_append,\n        raise_on_exhausted=False,\n    )\n    if leaf is None:\n        return PeekResult(step=None, path_tuple=(), iteration=None, item_id=None, exhausted=True)\n    step, path_tuple = leaf\n    top = cursor.frames[-1]\n    iteration = top.iteration if top.repeat_step_id is not None else None\n    item_id = top.item_id if top.repeat_step_id is not None else None\n    return PeekResult(\n        step=step,\n        path_tuple=path_tuple,\n        iteration=iteration,\n        item_id=item_id,\n        exhausted=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef gate_command(\n    slug: str,\n    command: str,\n    argv: Sequence[str],\n    *,\n    root: str | Path | None = None,\n    reentry: bool = False,\n) -> GateDecision:"

        Idea:
Implement Phase 5 (Lifecycle verbs split by audience) of the ArtAgents orchestrator V1 design per docs/orchestrator-v1-plan.md section 8. Phase 5 scope: introduce three audience-scoped verb groups under the top-level CLI:

  artagents next | ack | status | abort               (agent-facing, mid-run)
  artagents start | abort | status | runs ls          (operator)
  artagents author new | check | describe | test | compile | explain   (author; new/check/describe/compile already shipped in Phase 4)

Wire them into artagents/pipeline.py via subcommands. The agent-facing verbs and operator verbs should NOT collide with existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` (which stays). Specifically:

- `artagents start <orchestrator-id> --project <slug> [--name "..."]`: materializes the plan from compiled JSON, hashes it, writes active_run.json, appends run_started to events.jsonl, writes AGENT.md as the contract for whoever's driving.
- `artagents next`: reads active_run.json, derives cursor from events.jsonl (Phase 1 kernel API), prints next legal command/instruction with the prohibition preamble verbatim every call (so Stop hooks re-inject context). For code steps prints the exact argv to run; for attested prints instructions + ack template. For repeat:until iterations and repeat:for_each items, prints cumulative feedback / item ledger.
- `artagents ack <step> --decision {approve,retry,iterate,abort} [--evidence path] [--agent id | --actor name] [--feedback "..."] [--item id]`: validates ack against current step + decision rules (retry only after verifier failure; iterate only when repeat.until=user_approves), appends ack event, runs inline produces checks where applicable, advances cursor or rewinds.
- `artagents abort`: ends the run, writes run_aborted event, removes active_run.json.
- `artagents status`: derives cursor + summarizes plan + active step + recent events.
- `artagents runs ls [--project <slug>]`: file walk of runs/, summarizes by status.
- `artagents author test --fixture <name>`: runs the orchestrator with --dry-run --auto-approve against fixtures/<name>/, diffs events.jsonl against golden/<name>.events.jsonl. (`new`/`check`/`describe`/`compile` shipped in Phase 4.)
- `artagents author explain <orchestrator-id>`: prints natural-language description of the DAG (useful for LLMs verifying their output matches a request).

Phase 1 kernel (events.jsonl + active_run.json + gate above dispatch), Phase 2 step kinds (code/attested/nested), Phase 3 produces+repeat, Phase 4 DSL + author compile/check/describe/new are all shipped. Do NOT implement Stop-hook nudge (Phase 6), CAS (Phase 7), inbox (Phase 8), or golden-run author test runtime (Phase 9). For `author test`, scaffold the verb signature + a basic in-process diff but golden-run capture lives in Phase 9 — the test verb should return a clear "implement Phase 9 to capture golden runs" message if invoked without an existing golden file.

Tests: each verb has its own test file. start writes active_run.json + AGENT.md + run_started event. next prints prohibition preamble verbatim every call. ack rejects bad decisions, validates identity (--agent vs --actor matching ARTAGENTS_ACTOR), runs inline checks, advances/rewinds correctly. abort writes event and clears active_run. status shows correct cursor + recent events. runs ls finds runs across projects. author explain returns a sensible DAG summary. Existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` paths remain unchanged.

User notes and answers:
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-001 three step kinds: Task mode has exactly `code`, `attested`, and `nested` so execution, evidence, and delegation stay distinct.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-002 repeat body attributes: Iteration and fan-out are `repeat.until` and `repeat.for_each` body attributes so they apply uniformly to steps and nested bodies.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-003 plan naming: Runtime uses immutable `plan.json` instead of checklist naming because the structure is a tree with nested bodies and loops.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-004 event hash chain: `events.jsonl` uses plain `sha256(prev_hash + canonical_event_json)` with no HMAC because V1 needs an edit tripwire, not keyed tamper resistance.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-005 no index database: V1 ships without `.index.db` because file walking and grep over `events.jsonl` are adequate until measured otherwise.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-006 committed DSL: `artagents.orchestrate` Python DSL is the only committed authoring representation so source review happens in Python.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-007 generated build JSON: `<pack>/build/<orch>.json` is gitignored and root `.gitignore` excludes pack build outputs because runtime pins generated artifacts.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-008 per-project CAS: V1 uses only per-project `<slug>/.cas/<sha256>` storage because shared CAS adds coordination without current need.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-009 code boundary: `code` is deterministic argv, a strict superset of `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}`, may target `artagents executors run <name>`, and must not target `artagents orchestrators run`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-010 nested boundary: Sub-orchestrator delegation is exclusively `nested` so the gate can hash and pin child structure.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-011 gate checks: The gate validates active run presence, plan hash, event chain, and incoming command match before dispatch and prints the exact recovery command on rejection.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-012 gate ordering: The gate runs before `_prepare_project_request()` and `thread_wrapper.begin_orchestrator_run()` so rejected commands create zero project-run side effects.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-013 provenance surface: `events.jsonl` is the single write surface for task-mode provenance while thread provenance remains in `runs/<id>/run.json`.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-014 lifecycle dispatch: Task-mode lifecycle verbs extend `artagents/pipeline.py:15` and the existing `artagents orchestrators` CLI remains unchanged.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-015 task kernel namespace: New kernel modules live in `artagents/core/task/` to isolate gate, events, active-run, and env logic from legacy runners.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-016 structure guardrails: `TOP_LEVEL_ARTAGENTS_DIRS` adds `orchestrate` and `verify`, with `tests/test_doctor_setup.py` updated so doctor accepts the new packages.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-017 task run env: `ARTAGENTS_TASK_RUN_ID` is the integration surface for orchestrator, executor, and hype child calls to attach to the parent task run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-018 child output preservation: Task mode preserves child output dirs and mirrors hype artifacts under `runs/<task-run-id>/steps/<step-id>/produces/` while standalone behavior stays unchanged so `tests/test_project_runs.py` keeps passing.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-019 attestor identity: Agent attestations require `--agent`, human attestations require `--actor` matching `ARTAGENTS_ACTOR`, and self-acks are rejected.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-020 ack rules: `approve` advances, `retry` is only valid after verifier failure, `iterate --feedback` is only valid for `repeat.until=user_approves`, and `abort` ends the run.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-021 inline produces checks: Produces inline checks replace verifier substeps while `passes_test` remains a normal `code` step.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-022 semantic checks: `author check` rejects sentinel-only attested outputs because non-trivial artifacts need semantic validation.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-023 stop-hook preamble: Every `artagents next` output includes the prohibition preamble verbatim because repeated injection fights context decay.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-024 additive migration: Existing `OrchestratorDefinition` JSON manifests and `RUNTIME_KINDS={python,command}` keep working because V1 migration is additive.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-025 honor model: V1 is single-host and honor-based with strong logging because it does not defend against malicious local agents.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-026 cut points: Phase 3 is the frozen-plan runner ship point and Phase 5 is the author-friendly lifecycle ship point.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-027 canonical migration: `artagents/packs/builtin/hype/` is the canonical migration example because it exercises the existing executor pipeline and additive pack layout.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-028 phasing order: V1 implementation follows build phases 1-9 so kernel, step semantics, authoring, lifecycle, nudge, CAS, inbox, and golden tests land in dependency order.
- Ignored malformed settled decision line: SD-029 V1 infrastructure limits: V1 excludes daemon, web server, HMAC/keyed crypto, `.index.db`, and shared CAS so the implementation stays file-based, inspectable, and additive.

        Idea:
Implement Phase 5 (Lifecycle verbs split by audience) of the ArtAgents orchestrator V1 design per docs/orchestrator-v1-plan.md section 8. Phase 5 scope: introduce three audience-scoped verb groups under the top-level CLI:

  artagents next | ack | status | abort               (agent-facing, mid-run)
  artagents start | abort | status | runs ls          (operator)
  artagents author new | check | describe | test | compile | explain   (author; new/check/describe/compile already shipped in Phase 4)

Wire them into artagents/pipeline.py via subcommands. The agent-facing verbs and operator verbs should NOT collide with existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` (which stays). Specifically:

- `artagents start <orchestrator-id> --project <slug> [--name "..."]`: materializes the plan from compiled JSON, hashes it, writes active_run.json, appends run_started to events.jsonl, writes AGENT.md as the contract for whoever's driving.
- `artagents next`: reads active_run.json, derives cursor from events.jsonl (Phase 1 kernel API), prints next legal command/instruction with the prohibition preamble verbatim every call (so Stop hooks re-inject context). For code steps prints the exact argv to run; for attested prints instructions + ack template. For repeat:until iterations and repeat:for_each items, prints cumulative feedback / item ledger.
- `artagents ack <step> --decision {approve,retry,iterate,abort} [--evidence path] [--agent id | --actor name] [--feedback "..."] [--item id]`: validates ack against current step + decision rules (retry only after verifier failure; iterate only when repeat.until=user_approves), appends ack event, runs inline produces checks where applicable, advances cursor or rewinds.
- `artagents abort`: ends the run, writes run_aborted event, removes active_run.json.
- `artagents status`: derives cursor + summarizes plan + active step + recent events.
- `artagents runs ls [--project <slug>]`: file walk of runs/, summarizes by status.
- `artagents author test --fixture <name>`: runs the orchestrator with --dry-run --auto-approve against fixtures/<name>/, diffs events.jsonl against golden/<name>.events.jsonl. (`new`/`check`/`describe`/`compile` shipped in Phase 4.)
- `artagents author explain <orchestrator-id>`: prints natural-language description of the DAG (useful for LLMs verifying their output matches a request).

Phase 1 kernel (events.jsonl + active_run.json + gate above dispatch), Phase 2 step kinds (code/attested/nested), Phase 3 produces+repeat, Phase 4 DSL + author compile/check/describe/new are all shipped. Do NOT implement Stop-hook nudge (Phase 6), CAS (Phase 7), inbox (Phase 8), or golden-run author test runtime (Phase 9). For `author test`, scaffold the verb signature + a basic in-process diff but golden-run capture lives in Phase 9 — the test verb should return a clear "implement Phase 9 to capture golden runs" message if invoked without an existing golden file.

Tests: each verb has its own test file. start writes active_run.json + AGENT.md + run_started event. next prints prohibition preamble verbatim every call. ack rejects bad decisions, validates identity (--agent vs --actor matching ARTAGENTS_ACTOR), runs inline checks, advances/rewinds correctly. abort writes event and clears active_run. status shows correct cursor + recent events. runs ls finds runs across projects. author explain returns a sensible DAG summary. Existing `artagents orchestrators run|list|inspect|validate` paths remain unchanged.
